notes.title: Haunted by Evil
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37407646/e232c7c8801236d158399d72babbc23cbf10a478.png

Greetings everyone!

My name is Max. I am the founder of BKE Games Studio and the sole developer of the game Haunted by Evil :)
Only a couple of people are officially listed in the studio. They help me from time to time with the development of art and pixel art. Simply say, in the studio, besides me, there are two artists who make this game colorful and scary. ːsteammockingː

«Haunted by Evil» — is a psycho-intellectual horror about a man who fights nightmares in reality using his madness and weapons.

The story revolves around Patrick, a young guy working in the IT field. Patrick is a man with a difficult past that haunts him. It all starts with the fact that Patrick is tormented by nightmares that are very similar to real ones. On top of that, a missing of peoples incident from many years ago again occurs in the fictional city of Summerveil, and reaches the office where Patrick works. A horror game with unusual mechanics and atypical gameplay, which you have not yet met in horror games, are waiting for you!

The demo of the game will tell you how Patrick's story began in these nightmarish events of the game... ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Devlog: Developing and adding weapons
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37407646/aefb9cd7128495bdf7b6b8b1067f4350c65627b6.jpg


I'm glad to inform you that new weapon has been added:
1) .45 Pistol
2) М4
3) Shotgun

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37407646/f7422c0e9b87875c92d0fb36460478e3e11b2d15.png

Weapon damage was rebalanced:

 Axe damage was reduced to -5%
 .45 Pistol started inflicting more damage +10%
 M4 damage was reduced to -15% (as it was more effective in auto fire mode that the shotgun)
 Shotgun became more effective in close combat +35% damage, but the fire length was reduced from 7 to 4 tiles.


I plan to add explosive weapon such as grenades in the future. A new kind of powerful gun will be also added. It will be possible to craft grenades and ammo from collected materials. But I'll tell you about crafting in the following updates. ːsteamhappyː

See you soon!
Max Eliseev.
